methodology.type: database-disjoint (grouped by db_id), assignment inherited from v1
methodology.rationale: same 20 databases as v1; inheriting keeps every v1 item in its v1 partition and needs no new randomness
methodology.selection_inputs: db_id only; no model outputs or scores
methodology.file_format: source JSONL lines copied byte-for-byte, source order kept

retrospective_evaluation_note: Retrospective split: zero-shot Qwen2.5-Coder-3B (217/455), Qwen2.5-Coder-7B (287/455) and gpt-oss-120b (385/455) were evaluated on all 455 examples BEFORE this split existed. Per-partition scores of those runs are not an untouched held-out evaluation. Week 3 RAG uses train for the retrieval corpus, validation for development, and keeps test unused.
